in_arabic.name: خسايبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name of Arabic origin, derived from the Arabic root 'khasaba' which means 'to fight'. Khusaibah is a name for a young warrior, a youthful fighter, one who is ready and eager to engage in battle for the sake of truth and justice.

in_urdu.name: خوسائبہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: Ek urdu mein rahna hai ism, 'خوسائبہ' ka arabic se shuru hua hai, 'khasaba' ka root se hai jis ka tasnif 'lutna' hai. Yeh ism shabaabon ka naam hai, jinhe ek qital ke liye tamam tarah siyasat ke liye hai tayar hai. Yeh log sath-e-haq ki tasadduq ke liye jang leta hai.

in_pashto.name: خوسايبه
in_pashto.long_meaning: Ek pashto mein rahna hai ism, 'خوسايبه' ka arabic se shuru hua hai, 'khasaba' ka root se hai jis ka tasnif 'lutna' hai. Yeh ism shabaabon ka naam hai, jo jang ke liye tayar hai aur jis se pahunche hain. Yeh log haq ki tasadduq ke liye jang leta hai.
